Author: WayneXXDD
Name: Guildhest Queue (Wayne, Testing)
Punchline: Repeat guildhests while you handle the combat.
Description: Global client: select a guildhest or Guildhests roulette, automatically queue, confirm entry, and leave after completion before repeating. Combat remains manual. Standalone: no CBT, Yes Already, AutoDuty or other plugins required. Open /ghq.
Changelog: 0.1.0.0: Initial standalone guildhest queue loop with automatic entry, optional completion-only exit, run limits, and start/stop controls. Game behavior requires in-game testing.
